agent-team.name: Agent Team Personas
agent-team.description: Seven-agent development team personas (coordinator, backend-dev, frontend-dev, qa-reviewer, code-explorer, editor, tasker) with a setup command that installs them into .github/agents/, seeds charter fragments (per-project toolchain choice: npm-strict or pnpm-strict; plus quality/playwright-e2e), scaffolds the red-team lens catalog, and registers the qa-review workflow gate overlay.
agent-team.author: cgjedrem
